Fitness-specific listing copy — what translates differently

Fitness-app-centric listings use vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers describe workout and ring workflows — not a literal paste of US marketing:

健身 vs 健身应用 vs 健身+

US pages say “Apple Fitness”, “Fitness app”, or “Fitness+.” China storefront copy often uses 健身 for the workout ecosystem, 健身应用 when naming the app category or Fitness home integration, and 健身+ when gallery frames show subscription class catalogs, trainer-led tiles, or Fitness+ browse screens. AppLocale aligns phrasing with each screenshot frame — not one blanket term for every overlay.

训练 vs 活动闭环 vs 训练负荷

Workout session summaries, custom strength or HIIT builders, running routes, and cycling stats need 训练 — not English “Workout” burned into captions. Activity ring close screens and daily move/exercise/stand goals use 活动闭环 — the rings buyers recognize as Apple’s daily activity loop. Training load charts, recovery metrics, and load-vs-capacity trends use 训练负荷. Do not substitute 健康 or 健康记录 on ring frames — those belong to Health-app marketing.

Strength, HIIT, running, cycling & custom workouts

Gallery frames that show strength templates, HIIT intervals, outdoor running maps, or indoor cycling sessions need workout-type vocabulary Chinese fitness buyers expect — 力量训练, 高强度间歇, 跑步, 骑行 — aligned to what the screenshot actually displays, not generic “Get fit” slogans.

Mindful cooldown as a workout finish

When your gallery shows mindful cooldown or breathing recovery inside a Fitness workout flow — post-HIIT cool-down, stretch finish, or mindful minutes after a session — caption lines describe that workout finish (训练后的正念放松). When meditation or sleep is the entire product with no Fitness-app frames, that is a different lead scope — not this page.

健身奖励 & sharing activity

Achievement badges, monthly challenges, and award collections use 健身奖励. Share-activity cards, friend comparisons, and group workout invites need concise zh-Hans captions — 共享健身活动, 与好友比拼运动数据 — rather than English micro-copy (“Share Activity”, “Compete with friends”) that breaks gallery consistency.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need Fitness-relevant search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 健身, 健身应用, 训练, 活动闭环, and 训练负荷 each signal different intent from generic wellness keywords or Health terms like 健康记录.

What good Fitness-app zh-Hans listing copy looks like

Strong Fitness listings match frame content, use commerce-idiomatic zh-Hans, and stay within Connect character limits:

  • Subtitle names the Fitness surface — e.g. a ring-tracking app might use “活动闭环与训练记录同步” rather than a generic “Stay active” slogan
  • Keywords pack Fitness search intent — 健身, 健身应用, 训练, 活动闭环, or 训练负荷 as appropriate — not English “Fitness app” or “Activity rings” alone
  • Description opens with the workout flow buyers see — ring closes, custom workouts, Fitness+ classes, training load — not abstract wellness prose or Health vitals language
  • Each caption matches its frame — ring frames mention 活动闭环; workout lists mention 训练; Fitness+ tiles mention 健身+; awards mention 健身奖励
  • No medical or ranking over-claims — copy describes training and activity sync your app supports, not diagnostic outcomes, guaranteed weight loss, or Search rank promises
  • Consistent voice across fields — subtitle, keywords, description, and captions use the same Fitness vocabulary — not 健身 in the title and English “Workout” on every screenshot

FAQ

Does AppLocale implement HKWorkoutSession or write HealthKit workout code?

No. AppLocale rewrites App Store Connect metadata — name, subtitle, keywords, description, and screenshot caption lines on your zh-Hans product page. HKWorkoutSession, HKHealthStore queries, and watchOS workout runtime UI are engineering tasks outside AppLocale scope.

How is Apple Fitness listing copy different from Health or HealthKit marketing?

Apple Fitness listing copy covers gallery frames that lead with the Fitness app — Activity rings, workout sessions, Fitness+, training load, custom workouts, awards, and share-activity cards. Apple Health listing copy covers the Health app home, vitals, medications, and health records — see our Health listing guide. HealthKit listing copy covers companion apps whose story centers on syncing data via HealthKit APIs — see our HealthKit listing guide. It depends on each frame. 健身 and 健身应用 for ecosystem positioning. 健身+ for subscription catalog tiles. 训练 for workout sessions and custom workouts. 活动闭环 for Activity rings. 训练负荷 for training load charts. 健身奖励 for awards. Yes when your gallery shows mindful cooldown or breathing recovery as a workout finish inside Fitness — post-session cool-down on a Fitness-themed frame. Standalone meditation or sleep apps with no Fitness-app screenshots are a different lead scope.

No. Session timers, rep counters, ring animations, and watch complication text come from your app binary and iOS or watchOS localization — not App Store Connect listing fields. AppLocale covers product-page marketing copy only.
